# Support — Deveng Bot

## How to get help

1. **Docs:** start with the root [`README.md`](../README.md) (English) or [`README.tr.md`](../README.tr.md) (Türkçe).
2. **Bugs / features:** open a GitHub Issue using the templates.
3. **Security:** do **not** open a public issue — use [Security Advisories](https://github.com/pinqponq/deveng-bot/security/advisories/new). See [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md).

## What we can help with

- Self-host setup (Docker Compose, env, Discord OAuth redirects)
- Build / CI failures on `main`
- Reproducible bugs with redacted logs

## What we cannot provide here

- Hosting your production Discord bot for free
- Debugging leaked tokens (rotate them first)
- Custom paid feature work via Issues

## Community notes

- Prefer English for Issues/PRs (Türkçe özet eklemek sorun değil).
- Never paste `.env`, bot tokens, client secrets, or session keys.
